WITH filtered_results AS (
  SELECT driverId, points, laps
  FROM results
  WHERE grid > 12
),
driver_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    driverId,
    SUM(points) as total_points,
    AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) as avg_laps
  FROM filtered_results
  GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT
  AVG(total_points) as avg_points,
  AVG(avg_laps) as avg_of_avg_laps
FROM driver_stats
